 ### Scenario authoring (v58 working tree)
 - Audit first: step schema vs quiz state, Present-guard inventory, `nameClick=true` chain, step-change vs quiz state, solved sets vs steps, capture requirements, draft interplay, probe surface. Findings note → schema → consolidated contract (see `docs/learning-activities-Plan.md`, Stage 0).
 - Quiz steps (owner-reviewed, live-verified): capture rides Add/Update — live target → just-solved answer → shown comp (if resolvable) → main-chain default (if resolvable) → classic; disarmed Update clears with toast; any menu-carrying Add stores a deferred task (`quiz.mol: ""`) from the armed/solved/intent molecule — the quiz follows every picked molecule (pinned-`mol` mismatch stays fail-closed for menu-less steps). Select button stays usable in pick mode. `step.quiz {kind, mode, mol}` + `requireSolution` (default on, drawer checkbox); `is-quiz` badge; Διάδραση row hidden on quiz steps (interaction forced on). Present auto-arms with fresh picks + solved-state cleared (revisits re-quiz); gate holds forward moves only on a live task-mode target; solved steps unlock free exploration (reps pickable, other comps armable as ungraded practice). Quiz intent (`__mulerQuizIntent {mode, mol}`) survives menu-building teardown, mol-guarded; cleared on toggle-off, explicit deselect, reselect, Present entry. 15 Present-blocked pick/arm/paint/hover/Esc guards; menu picks arm deferred quizzes via the menu-pick hook (pure-deferred apply never arms stale). Reselect/resume-Present clears solved sets. Menu picks start blank (leaked mode/box/paint cleared on switch); unsolved picks arm blank-but-live, solved picks show the solved display (green, no re-arm), same-mol re-click stays a retake. Any unsolved component arms (task or ungraded practice); solved components fall through to the classic highlight without killing a live task. Gate holds while the step task is unsolved for the relevant molecule once armed (fail-open when never armed). `fClearHighlights` now resets the component-green records (no ghost repaint); quiz steps capture a clean naming mode and the exact authoring comp state (`quiz.preSolved`), restored as solved display on apply — revisits never re-quiz. Probe `tools/muler-harness/probe-scenario-quiz.js` (+ blank-slate, solved-display return/stay-solved, free practice, disarm-guard, preSolved). `?v=58.7`.
 
+- Multi-comp steps (`?v=58.8`): quiz done = every `.quizTodo` solved, not just the primary auto-arm mode (`fMulerQuizTodoModes()` = capable − solved − hidden, mirrors paint). Author pre-solved comps get `.freeComp` (normal classic, marker only); auto-arm prefers primary else first todo; gate/task/unlock all use the todo set (fail-open when never armed kept). Non-quiz steps in Present tear down student mode (disarm, picks cleared, select off, debounce cleared, classic repaint) so no tint stall. Post-solve stays unblocked while todos remain (next box arms with blank picks); full-done unlocks free exploration. `node --check` clean.
+- Went live 2026-11-18: `index.html` redirect (meta + script + fallback link) → `mulermoc-nom-58.html`; the 15 headless 2D probes retargeted to `-58.html` (`probe-compare55-56.js` stays cross-version by design), harness README describes the v58 live tree. v57 files untouched/frozen. Browser Present matrix remains owner-side.
+
+- Quiz steps hide the drawer's “Εμφάνιση ονομασίας” master (a quiz with hidden naming is unanswerable) and force `show.naming`/`nameClick` on at capture, Update, validate (imported/legacy files coerce silently) and apply; the master can no longer store `false`. `?v=58.9`.
+- Drawer rows carry `data-sc-row` (`viewers|naming|quiz|menu-groups`) and every checkbox a `data-sc-role` (`ctl-2D`, `ctl-3D`, `naming`, `name-settings`, `name-click`, `name-eye`, `require-solution`, `menu-group-*`); no ids (drawers repeat per card). `requireSolution` moves out of the name row into its own `.scShowRow.scStepQuizSettings` row (`data-sc-row="quiz"`), rendered only on quiz steps — classic steps show no quiz settings. Probe prefers the roles (text match kept as fallback) and asserts quiz-row presence/absence. `?v=58.10`.
